mapper.insert: INSERT INTO hotel (name, address, phone, check_in_time, check_out_time, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE hotel SET name=#{name}, address=#{address}, phone=#{phone}, check_in_time=#{checkInTime}, check_out_time=#{checkOutTime}, status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM hotel ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
